summary: Japan Bank for International Cooperation filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $1.5 billion 4.625% guaranteed bond issuance due 2036, fully guaranteed by Japan. The bonds are offered at 99.834% of par, yielding net proceeds of ~99.659% after underwriting discount of 0.175%, with expected settlement on July 2, 2026. The offering is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. No special-situation characteristics are present; the filing is an ordinary shelf takedown of debt securities.
